title: Drafts
emptyBody: Use draft orders to take orders over the phone, send invoices to customers, and collect payments.

form.deleteConfirm: Delete this draft order? This cannot be undone.
form.convertedBanner: This draft was converted into an order.
form.customItemHint: Custom items are staged on this screen only. Saving a draft still requires catalog products — remove customs before Save, or wait for API support.
form.customItemsBlockSave: Remove custom items before saving — draft orders only accept catalog products today.
form.sendInvoiceSoon: Sending invoices from draft orders is not available yet.
form.sendInvoiceModalDesc: Send an email invoice to the customer with an itemized breakdown and a link to complete payment.
form.sendInvoiceCustomMessagePlaceholder: Write an optional message or payment instructions for the customer...
form.sendInvoiceRecipientRequired: Please enter a valid recipient email address.
form.saveBeforeSendInvoice: Please save changes before sending the invoice.
form.addProductToCalculate: Add a product to calculate total and view payment options
form.paymentTermsHint: The order is created unpaid and its payment falls due after these terms. Mark it as paid from the order page once you receive the money.
form.noteModalHint: Notes stay on the draft for your team. They are not shown as a customer timeline comment.
form.storeDiscountsHint: Your shop's active coupons. They are priced when the order is created, for the customer on this draft.
form.couponSearchPlaceholder: Search coupons or enter a code
form.noActiveCoupons: No active coupons in your store.
form.noCouponMatches: No active coupon matches. Apply the code to check it.
form.couponNeedsCustomer: Needs a customer on the draft: this coupon is limited per customer.
form.couponUnavailable: No longer available. Remove it before creating the order.
form.couponPricedAtConversion: Priced when the order is created
form.couponPreviewUnavailable: Could not be previewed for this order. It is checked again when the order is created.
form.couponNotFound: No active coupon with this code.
form.couponNotYetActive: This coupon is not active yet.
form.couponNotApplicable: This coupon does not apply to this order.
form.couponCheckFailed: The code could not be checked. Try again.
form.couponLimitReached: You can apply up to {max} coupons.
form.couponEstimateNote: Store discount figures are estimates. The order's price is calculated when it is created.
form.couponErrorNeedsCustomer: A coupon on this draft is limited per customer. Add a customer or remove the coupon.
form.couponErrorInvalid: A coupon on this draft is not an active coupon of your store. Remove it and try again.
form.couponErrorNotApplicable: A coupon on this draft no longer applies to this order. Remove it or change the order.
form.couponErrorUsedUp: A coupon on this draft has reached its usage limit for this customer. Remove it to create the order.
form.customerErrorDeleted: This customer's account has been deleted, so the draft can't be saved with them. Remove the customer or choose a different one.
form.shippingNeedAddress: Add a customer's address to get shipping and delivery options.
form.shippingNeedProducts: Add catalog products to quote live shipping rates. You can still set a custom fee below.
form.shippingNoMerchantRates: No rate matches this address. Enter a custom fee for your own delivery.
form.shippingNoCarrierRates: No carrier rates for this destination. Enter a fee to continue, or check shipping settings.
form.shippingEnterCustom: Enter a name and price for this method.
form.shippingQuoteCustomerInvalid: Shipping rates can't be quoted because this draft's customer is out of date or was deleted. To see rates, choose the customer again, pick another or remove them. You can still set a custom fee below.
form.shippingQuoteFailed: Shipping rates couldn't be loaded. You can still set a custom fee below, or close this window and try again.
form.merchantChannelHint: Personal shipping priced by your zones and rates.
form.carrierChannelHint: Live carrier prices from your connected account.
form.carrierNotReady: Connect and verify your OTO account in Shipping settings first.
form.carrierUnavailable: Carrier rates are unavailable for this quote right now.
form.customShippingHint: Set any name and price for this order.
form.languageHint: This customer will receive notifications in this language.
form.acceptsEmailMarketing: Customer agreed to receive marketing emails.
form.acceptsSmsMarketing: Customer agreed to receive SMS marketing text messages.
form.marketingConsentHint: You should ask your customers for permission before you subscribe them to your marketing emails or SMS.
form.defaultAddressHint: The primary address of this customer.
form.notesPrivateHint: Notes are private and won't be shared with the customer.
form.needProduct: Add at least one catalog product before saving
form.saveBeforeConvert: Save your changes before creating the order

notFound.title: Draft order not found
notFound.body: It may have been deleted or converted into an order.
